lines: In every way being even, the tattva-knower liberates beasts by will alone; Śiva directly — therefore him should worship always.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvathā vartamāno@pi tattvavinmocayetpaśūn icchayaiva śivaḥ sākṣāttasmāttaṃ pūjayetsadā
